_note: India context inputs (CLAUDE.md Section 10). status: sourced | assumption | placeholder. per_state overrides use the 2-letter state codes of config/markets.json. Anything not sourced is shown as '(estimate)'.

freight_rs_per_tonne_km.source: 14 ft LCV quoted at Rs 20-35 per km (Indian truck-rate guides, 2025-26) divided by an assumed 2.5 t payload; replace with FPO interviews per region

KA.note: 0% on fruit and vegetables; user charges not found

AP.source: AP Agricultural Marketing Dept, levied on purchases, https://spsnellore.ap.gov.in/agricultural-marketing-department/
AP.note: Levied on purchases; deducting it from the seller is an assumption

diesel_l_per_km.source: Tata 407-class, published 7-10 km/l, lower end for loaded running; https://trucksbuses.com/trucks/cargo-truck/tata-sfc-407-bsiv/mileage

co2_kg_per_l_diesel.note: Standard diesel combustion factor; primary source still to cite

truck_speed_kmph.source: Not yet sourced. Used only when no routed drive time is supplied (haversine fallback); while null, such requests fail with code drive_time_unavailable.
truck_speed_kmph.note: Candidates found, not chosen: about 20 km/h (CSIR-CRRI citing a TCI-IIM study, includes check-post delays); 37-38 km/h on national highways (secondary press report).

rescue_radius_km.source: CLAUDE.md D31: unsold stock at a city mandi goes to outlets in and around that city, not 300 km away

road_factor.source: CLAUDE.md Section 8.1 (fallback when routing fails; distance marked approx.)

max_data_age_days.source: CLAUDE.md D25: a market whose latest report is older than this is listed but never chosen (same rule as D17); 7 = the A7 window

dump_share_table.unit: share unsold or dumped, by arrival ratio R (r_below is the exclusive upper bound of the band)
dump_share_table.source: CLAUDE.md Section 9 Step 6 heuristic; calibrate by FPO interview

below_cost_dump_share.unit: minimum share unsold or dumped at the default market when its mid net value per kg is below the crop's harvest cost (u_default = max(u(R), value))
below_cost_dump_share.source: reuses Section 9 u(R) table values; D12

biogas_yield.source: to source: published anaerobic digestion yield for fruit and vegetable waste, or the partner unit's figure (CLAUDE.md D21). Null renders 'not yet estimated'.
